texts.EducationPlanExecution:ReviewGrading: Review original assessment grading and versions
texts.EducationPlanExecution:Title: Plan execution and teacher review
texts.EducationPlanExecution:Description: Execution control is separate from plan content versions. Pausing, ending or terminating stops new activities and preserves submitted facts. Started formal assessments keep their original timer, save and submission rules.
texts.EducationPlanExecution:EvidenceNotice: Review the original evidence, activity history and new-question reassessment grading. These are actual records and confirmed-question counts, not proof of mastery or effectiveness. Missing records are not zero marks; self-reported completion and sealing are not assessment outcomes.
texts.EducationPlanExecution:PrivateReason: Private reason, evidence limits and reflection (owner only)
texts.EducationPlanExecution:Confirmation: I reviewed the current evidence and uncertainty. This decision does not declare mastery or effectiveness; the reason is not sent to the student.
texts.EducationPlanExecution:Adjustment: Adjusting pauses new execution. Edit, save, confirm and publish a new version, then explicitly resume. Ended or terminated plans cannot be republished; create a new plan for the next cycle.
texts.EducationPlanExecution:StudentNotice: Paused, ended or terminated plans cannot start new activities. Started formal assessments keep their original rules. Submitted facts remain and do not imply mastery.
texts.KnowPulse:PlanGeneration:Invalid: Generation parameters or output failed validation. Review targets, schedule and workload, or continue manually.
texts.KnowPulse:PlanGeneration:Busy: You already have a pending generation. Check its status first.
texts.KnowPulse:PlanGeneration:Quota: Today's configured generation limit has been reached. Manual planning remains available.
texts.KnowPulse:PlanGeneration:Changed: The source, execution or schedule changed. Reopen the current report.
texts.KnowPulse:PlanGeneration:Conflict: The operation, generation source or target plan does not match. Recover the original request or create a new plan.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Title: AI teaching plan drafts
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:FromReport: Draft a plan for this student with AI
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Description: The model receives only selected point summaries, subject, textbook and scheduling constraints. Names, accounts, answer bodies, other students and private observations are excluded. Editable text steps still require separate saving, teacher confirmation and publication. Manual planning remains available.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Minutes: Maximum estimated minutes for the whole plan
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Limits: Select 1–20 points and 5–10080 minutes; output has 4–20 steps. Insufficient evidence requires diagnosis first. Reassessment is a proposal; the teacher must separately link a formal new-question assessment.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:NewRound: Explicitly request another round (may incur cost)
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:UnknownUsage: Usage is not fully confirmed; an interruption does not prove there was no upstream charge. Reading or refreshing never reissues the model request.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:SourceChanged: This job's source or schedule is no longer applicable. Review the current report before adopting a new draft.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:SavedPlan: Open the current saved teacher plan
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:ReviewHint: Review every target, step, workload and success condition. Opening the editor only fills a draft. Authorized materials can be added through the existing picker after saving.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:NoReceipt: No original receipt was found yet. This is not proof of failure; recheck before resending the exact request.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:NotReady: The draft is incomplete or its source changed; it cannot be adopted yet.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Origin: From AI generation {0}; the current text still requires teacher review.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Failure:1: The account, permission or teaching scope changed. Output is withheld.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Failure:2: Evidence, source or schedule changed. Start from the current report.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Failure:3: The model is unconfigured, unavailable, failed or timed out. Continue manually or configure the teaching-plan usage in model management.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Failure:4: Output failed structure, target, diagnosis, schedule or workload validation. No adoptable result was saved.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Failure:5: Execution or persistence did not finish. No existing plan was automatically overwritten.
texts.EducationPlanGeneration:Failure:6: The execution heartbeat expired. Upstream usage may have occurred; another round requires an explicit request.
texts.EducationTrend:Title: Assessment score trends
texts.EducationTrend:Description: Ordered by effective submission time; classes use the latest complete-score submission. Incomplete records use an available submission time or the deadline. Each row compares only with its immediate predecessor. Score changes do not establish an intervention effect.
texts.EducationTrend:ClassMean: Class mean of complete confirmed scores
texts.EducationTrend:CountsHint: Only complete confirmed papers enter the mean. Measured zero scores count; missing scores do not. Original assignments and currently included students are separate. Teacher visibility does not release scores to students.
texts.EducationTrend:Empty: No assessment records in this scope.
texts.EducationTrend:Assigned: Originally assigned {0}; currently included {1}; complete confirmed scores {2}
texts.EducationTrend:States: Pending grading {0} · absent {1} · not started {2} · in progress {3} · awaiting seal {4} · submitted outside window {5}
texts.EducationTrend:BasisHint: Point choices come from the same report window. Evidence below is restricted to this assessment. No evidence does not mean a zero score or no learning.
texts.EducationTrend:NoBasis: No confirmed scoring evidence for this point in this assessment.
texts.EducationTrend:Invalid: A valid report, snapshot and teaching scope are required. Reopen from teacher reports.
texts.EducationTrend:Comparable: Comparable with the immediately preceding assessment; score changes do not establish an intervention effect.
texts.EducationTrend:Limit:64: Different included or completely scored students
texts.EducationTrend:Limit:128: Incomplete frozen question metadata prevents direct comparison
texts.WeChat:Title: WeChat account binding
texts.WeChat:Introduction: Bind WeChat to your verified account. Existing personal-material and teaching permissions remain unchanged.
texts.WeChat:NotConfigured: WeChat binding is not enabled. Contact your school or platform administrator.
texts.WeChat:CodeNotice: Codes expire after five minutes. A new code invalidates previous pending codes for this application. Revoke an existing active binding before replacing it.
texts.WeChat:ConfirmPassword: Confirm this account's current password (Web only)
texts.WeChat:Consent: I will enter the code only in my own WeChat application and confirm that it should use this account.
texts.WeChat:CodeTransient: This code is displayed only here and is not saved in browser storage. If the response is lost or you leave this page, generate a new code with your current password.
texts.WeChat:RevokeNotice: Unbinding stops subsequent access from WeChat sessions using this binding. Account data and learning records are retained; a new binding requires Web account verification.
texts.WeChat:RebindRequired: Account verification changed; unbind and verify again
texts.KnowPulse:WeChat:InvalidCode: WeChat login could not be verified. Obtain a fresh login code and try again.
texts.KnowPulse:WeChat:Unavailable: WeChat verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
texts.KnowPulse:WeChat:InvalidBinding: Account or binding verification failed. Check the current account, password, application and code.
texts.KnowPulse:WeChat:AlreadyBound: An active binding already exists. Review it in the verified Web account before replacing it.
texts.EducationWorkspace:Title: Teaching and learning workspace
texts.EducationWorkspace:Introduction: Use the teacher or student identity confirmed by your school. Each destination checks your current access again.
texts.EducationWorkspace:PersonalLibraryHint: Your personal materials remain yours. School membership alone does not give others access.
texts.EducationWorkspace:NoIdentity: There is no current, confirmed teacher or student school identity for this account. Ask your school to check your records; personal-library access is separate.
texts.EducationWorkspace:NoTeaching: No current teaching assignment. You can continue using your own materials.
texts.EducationWorkspace:NoEnrollment: No current class enrollment. Ask your school to check your class records.
texts.EducationWorkspace:NoPermissions: This account has no enabled action for this workspace. Ask your school to check your feature permissions.
texts.EducationWorkspace:ObservedAt: Identities checked at {0} UTC. Access is checked again when you open a feature.
texts.EducationWorkspace:AccountChanged: Your login identity changed. Refresh to load the current account.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageCacheConsent: Allow pending images to be buffered in this browser for network or refresh recovery. The cache expires logically after 24 hours and is cleared on later use. Upload confirmation or explicit abandonment clears its buffer. Browser clearing or changing devices can still lose unconfirmed content. Take care on shared devices.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageCacheRequired: Acknowledge the local image buffering notice before selecting an image or retrying an upload.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageCacheWarning: Local image buffers could not be accessed or fully cleared. Saved answers and submissions are unchanged. Retry cleanup; failed cleanup records are retained for recovery.
texts.EducationAttempt:Synchronizing: Checking with the server; wait for confirmation.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageCannotDisplay: The image cannot be displayed. Check the original file format; this does not change its bytes or save/submission receipt.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageUploaded: Image upload confirmed: {0}. It becomes a saved answer only after this question is saved.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageRetryFile: Pending image: {0}. Recover its receipt or retry from the local buffer. If the buffer is missing or expired, select the same content for the original operation.
texts.EducationAttempt:ReselectImage: Select the original image to retry
texts.EducationAttempt:Conflict: This draft is based on a different server answer, or its original version is unknown. Compare the current server answer and local draft below, then choose explicitly before saving.
texts.EducationAttempt:ServerUnanswered: No answer has been saved for this question.
texts.EducationAttempt:LocalAnswerBelow: Your local draft remains in the editor below. You can discard it to use the current server answer.
texts.EducationAttempt:UseLocal: Keep the local draft after comparison
texts.EducationAttempt:UseLocalHint: Have you compared both answers? You can then save this local draft to replace the server answer for this question. This confirmation itself does not save to the server.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageLimits: JPEG, PNG and WebP; up to {0:N0} bytes per image and {1} images per question. Uploading and saving the question are separate steps.
texts.EducationAttempt:AddImage: Choose or capture an answer image
texts.EducationAttempt:ReplaceSelection: Choose a replacement; keep the old image until upload confirmation
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageDraftScope: Image order and rotation; save this question after changes
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageLinked: The last checked server answer includes this image, position and rotation.
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageLocalOnly: This image, position or rotation is only in the local draft and has no question-save confirmation.
texts.EducationAttempt:RemoveImageHint: Remove this image from the local draft? Save the question to update the server answer. Original files and saved history are retained.
texts.EducationAttempt:AnswerImageAlt: Preview of your original answer image
texts.EducationAttempt:InvalidImage: The image type, size or read result does not meet current limits. Select a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
texts.EducationAttempt:WrongRetryImage: This image differs from the original pending content. Select the original image to retry the same operation.
texts.EducationAttempt:UploadUnconfirmed: The upload is not fully confirmed and is not a valid answer. Recover the receipt or retry with the original image.
texts.EducationFormal:Title: Formal assessment and review
texts.EducationFormal:Scope: Bind an owned published assessment with new questions for these curriculum points. Stopping or replacing the plan prevents new starts; existing attempts keep their original deadlines.
texts.EducationFormal:CandidateScope: Candidates match scope and timing. Preview rechecks point coverage, novelty and current versions.
texts.EducationFormal:FrozenQuestions: Review frozen questions and answers (teacher only)
texts.EducationFormal:ConfirmOrigins: I checked original questions and known original relationships.
texts.EducationFormal:ConfirmNew: These are new questions for the same targets; a new ID alone does not prove novelty.
texts.EducationFormal:ConfirmNoHints: I compared the full plan with the frozen questions and found no hints or answers for this assessment.
texts.EducationFormal:ConfirmExact: I reviewed the exact provided plan and frozen questions; this correction preserves prior reviews.
texts.EducationFormal:SealedCount: Sealed formal submissions: {0}; teacher evaluation is still required.
texts.EducationFormal:Permission: Assessment permission is required to view formal attempt details.
texts.EducationFormal:Stopped: New starts are stopped; existing attempts keep their original deadlines.
texts.EducationAttempt:Title: Take assessment
texts.EducationAttempt:ServerTimes: Started: {0}; deadline: {1}; last server check: {2}. The server enforces deadlines; refresh to check.
texts.EducationAttempt:Sealed: Submission sealed: {0}, at {1}. The teacher releases results separately.
texts.EducationAttempt:LocalDrafts: {0} questions have local drafts without server-save confirmation. Refresh preserves this tab's drafts; closing the tab may lose unsaved work.
texts.EducationAttempt:ExistingImages: Preserving {0} linked answer images. This page does not yet add or edit images.
texts.EducationAttempt:DiscardDraftHint: Discard this unconfirmed local draft and show the server answer? Saved answers are unchanged.
texts.EducationAttempt:SubmitHint: Save each answer before submitting. Only server-confirmed answers are sealed; unsaved work is excluded. The server handles deadline sealing.
texts.EducationAttempt:ConfirmSavedOnly: Submit only server-saved answers; I cannot edit after submission.
texts.EducationMaterial:Title: Activity materials
texts.EducationMaterial:ReadHint: Only the assigned version and selected attachments are provided. Reading or downloading does not mean completion or mastery. Report unavailable material to your teacher.
texts.EducationMaterial:Unavailable: This material is unavailable; further body and attachment reads are blocked. Report unavailable material. Historical submissions remain under their own access rules.
texts.EducationMaterial:ChooseHint: Select an exact version and necessary attachments, then save, confirm and publish the plan. Changing materials requires a new plan version. Limits: 50 materials, 10 per step, 10 attachments per material.
texts.EducationMaterial:SharedOnly: Find school shares explicitly allowed for student assignments
texts.EducationMaterial:Label: Material name shown to the student
texts.EducationMaterial:AttachmentsHint: Select only necessary attachments. Shared attachments also require the author's download permission. Unselected attachments are not provided.
texts.EducationMaterial:SaveFirst: Save the plan draft before choosing activity materials.
texts.EducationMaterial:HintReview: Before confirming no hints, review the exact referenced material bodies and attachments. New no-hints confirmation is blocked while a material is unavailable.
texts.SchoolKnowledge:Use:AssignToStudents: Allow school teachers to assign this version to their students (attachments also require download permission)
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:MaterialUnavailab: An assigned material or necessary attachment is unavailable. Check the version or permission, or report difficulty; do not report completion for blocked material.
texts.EducationAttempt:SyncAndReview: Sync all local drafts and review
texts.EducationAttempt:DraftExclusion: Local changes are not saved; the existing server answer, if any, will be submitted.
texts.EducationAttempt:UnuploadedSelections: Failed or abandoned local image selections
texts.EducationAttempt:ImageNotUploaded: This local selection did not finish synchronization confirmation and is not a newly saved answer. Reselect it or remove this local record; see the server upload status below.
texts.EducationAttempt:ExcludedImages: Uploads excluded from the saved answer
texts.EducationAttempt:UnlinkedImageHint: These are not linked to the current saved answers. They may include replaced images, confirmed uploads waiting for a save, and unconfirmed uploads. They are excluded from this submission; existing history is retained.
texts.EducationAttempt:UploadedUnlinked: Uploaded, not linked to the current saved answer
texts.EducationAttempt:ConfirmExclusions: I have reviewed every missing answer and excluded local draft/image above. Submit only the saved server answers.
texts.EducationAttempt:SubmitExclusionsAgain: Submit only the saved answers now? The missing answers and excluded drafts/images listed above will not be included. Local drafts will remain on this browser; the sealed submission cannot be edited.
texts.EducationAttempt:SubmitAgain: Submit the reviewed saved answers now? The sealed submission cannot be edited.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationAssessment:Preparatio: Review the saved answers and exclusions before submitting.
The saved answers or image uploads changed. Reload and review the exclusions again.
texts.EducationAttempt:Leave: Leave this page? Unsaved drafts and pending commands are stored only in this tab and may be lost when it closes.
texts.EducationAttempt:DraftMismatch: Local drafts do not match this attempt version. Check server content before clearing local data.
texts.EducationAttempt:ResetLocal: Clear this tab's drafts and pending command
texts.EducationAttempt:ResetLocalHint: Clear unsaved answers and pending commands in this tab? A sent command may already have succeeded; try receipt recovery first. Clearing does not undo server data.
texts.EducationEvidence:Source:FormalAssessmen: Actual provision of a formally bound plan
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:AssessmentNotNew: Question coverage, prior attempts, exposure or original relationships do not satisfy new-question requirements. Select another assessment and preview again.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:AssessmentStopped: This activity does not allow new attempts. Contact your teacher; existing attempts retain their original deadlines.
texts.EducationActivity:ActivityOnly: Activity reports do not change grades or mastery. Explain a restart; reporting difficulty after completion blocks the activity and preserves its history.
texts.EducationActivity:Overdue: Past the planned deadline; report the actual situation.
texts.EducationActivity:FormalAssessment: This step requires a formal assessment assigned by the teacher. Activity preparation and difficulty reports cannot replace starting or submitting that assessment.
texts.EducationActivity:SharedText: Explanation or reflection to submit to the teacher
texts.EducationActivity:ShareConfirmation: I choose to submit this text to the teacher of this plan.
texts.EducationActivity:CompleteConfirmation: I confirm activity completion only; grades and mastery require assessment evidence.
texts.EducationActivity:WorkloadScope: UTC dates; at most 31 days. Remaining estimates are checked plan by plan for currently accessible published plans. Refresh after progress changes; waiting, withdrawn or inaccessible plans are excluded.
texts.EducationActivity:Uncounted: Published plans excluded by current availability: {0}
texts.EducationActivity:Subject: Subject
texts.EducationActivity:Reenter: Open this plan from My teaching plans to load its current public version.
texts.EducationActivity:Historical: Historical or withdrawn version: records remain available; new execution and handling are stopped.
texts.EducationActivity:ProvidedAt: First provided by the service at {0}.
texts.EducationActivity:PrivateNote: Handling note visible only to you
texts.EducationActivity:HandlingConfirmation: The student will see the handling time only. This note remains private to me.
texts.EducationPlan:HintExplanation: Check the exact plan version delivered for this frozen question. A no-hint decision applies only to this context; it cannot cancel answer delivery, repeated attempts or known original relationships.
texts.EducationPlan:HintExact: I checked this exact delivered plan and the frozen question answers and hints.
texts.EducationPlan:Title: Teaching plans
texts.EducationPlan:Description: Draft from current student evidence. Private notes and student content remain separate; save, confirm and publish.
texts.EducationPlan:DraftFromStudent: Draft a plan for this student
texts.EducationPlan:SourceChanged: Evidence changed. Recompute the source report, load its current basis, then save and confirm a new version.
texts.EducationPlan:Name: Plan title
texts.EducationPlan:StepHint: Publishing assigns versioned learning activities. Activities record progress only; diagnostic and reassessment steps require formal assessments assigned by the teacher.
texts.EducationPlan:PrivateHint: Private notes, scoring, qualification reasons and sources are not copied into student content.
texts.EducationPlan:Reason: Reason for adjustment, publication or withdrawal (private)
texts.EducationPlan:ConfirmTarget: I checked the student, goals, steps, dates and effort.
texts.EducationPlan:ConfirmMaterials: I am authorized to provide the inline materials to this student.
texts.EducationPlan:ConfirmSafe: Student content contains no private sources, other people's information, internal diagnosis or unreleased assessment facts.
texts.EducationPlan:ChooseSource: Start from a student report or choose an existing plan.
texts.EducationPlan:MyDescription: Only plans published to you appear. Waiting, stale and withdrawn states remain distinct; drafts are private.
texts.EducationPlan:Empty: No plans have been published to you.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:Invalid: Check plan content, dates, recipient, saved revision and confirmations. Dates must fit current teaching, term and enrollment.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:SourceChanged: Student evidence changed. Refresh the report and save a new plan basis.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:OperationConflict: An operation ID cannot be reused for different plan content.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingPlan:DiagnosticRequire: Evidence is insufficient. Start with a diagnostic step before confirming.
texts.EducationGrowth:Title: My growth
texts.EducationGrowth:Description: View your open official results and independent evidence by subject, textbook and teaching context. Hidden results are excluded. Subjects are not combined into an ability score.
texts.EducationGrowth:Loading: Checking current access and building a consistent version…
texts.EducationGrowth:Window: Up to {0} days; start inclusive, end exclusive. Future times are invalid.
texts.EducationGrowth:Empty: No open official results are available. Refresh after your teacher opens results.
texts.EducationGrowth:TrendHint: Lines connect adjacent results only when coverage, maximum, nominal difficulty and scoring basis match. Papers are not necessarily equated. Repeated questions add no independent evidence; higher scores do not prove an intervention effect.
texts.EducationGrowth:ChartLabel: Open assessment score ratios; complete values and comparison limits are in the table below.
texts.EducationGrowth:NoAssessments: No open assessment records in this window. Absence, incompletion or missing evidence is not zero.
texts.EducationGrowth:StaleEvidence: Latest evidence is outside the window recency requirement
texts.EducationGrowth:Restricted: Some evidence is not open for full review. Question details are withheld; refresh after review opens.
texts.EducationGrowth:NoBasis: No question-level evidence is currently available for review.
texts.EducationGrowth:Comparable: Same nominal basis; scores may be compared
texts.EducationGrowth:Limit:32: An adjacent result has no valid score
texts.EducationReport:Title: Learning reports
texts.EducationReport:Description: Confirmed scores in current class and textbook scope. Ratios reflect independent evidence, not ability probabilities.
texts.EducationReport:Pending: Check the saved command receipt or retry exactly.
texts.EducationReport:NoReceipt: No committed receipt found. A failed or denied read does not prove the write was not committed.
texts.EducationReport:AbandonHint: Clear only the local command? It may already be committed. Check its receipt first; reload before another write.
texts.EducationReport:WindowHint: Start inclusive, end exclusive, no future times. Own overlapping published tasks are included. Unanswered, pending and absent remain distinct. Use a new report for another window.
texts.EducationReport:ScopeChanged: Scope or rule changed. Confirm current mappings and recompute, or use a new report with a suitable window.
texts.EducationReport:Stale: No current result available. Background processing checks sources and recomputes. Reload for progress; outdated details are hidden.
texts.EducationReport:NoRule: Rule missing or disabled. Valid ratios remain insufficient evidence; no valid evidence is shown as —.
texts.EducationReport:Rule: Rule {0}: at least {1} independent questions / {2} assessments, evidence within {3} days, target {4}
texts.EducationReport:TeacherOnly: Teacher reports may include unreleased confirmed grades. Students can only read official released results.
texts.EducationReport:ComparisonHint: Scores from different papers do not directly establish progress or regression. No causal claims are made.
texts.EducationReport:RulesHint: School managers confirm window, evidence counts, recency and target. No uncalibrated threshold is supplied. Corrections and disabling retain previous versions.
texts.EducationReport:Subject: Subject
texts.EducationReport:Target: Target ratio (>0 to 1, up to four decimals)
texts.EducationReport:ConfirmPolicy: Confirm this is the subject rule adopted by the school
texts.KnowPulse:LearningReport:OperationConfli: An operation ID cannot be reused for different content.
texts.KnowPulse:LearningReport:Capacity: Report capacity exceeded. Narrow its scope.
texts.KnowPulse:LearningReport:Invalid: Invalid report source or state. Reload.
texts.EducationEvidence:Title: Learning evidence review
texts.EducationEvidence:Back: Back to grading and original answers
texts.EducationEvidence:Explanation: Qualifications do not change answers or grades. Declaring independent evidence still requires checking attempt history, original relationships and hints. A missing record is not proof of no prior exposure.
texts.EducationEvidence:Qualification: Use of this answer as evidence
texts.EducationEvidence:Unverified: Unverified; not yet eligible as independent evidence.
texts.EducationEvidence:NoHints: I checked that this attempt received no answers or hints
texts.EducationEvidence:NewRequirements: I checked the requirements and new assessment value
texts.EducationEvidence:OriginsChecked: I checked originals, copies and variants
texts.EducationEvidence:OriginalsHint: Choose a frozen question from your graded assessments of this student in the same school and subject. Confirmed links support later deduplication; correcting a link retains its history.
texts.EducationEvidence:Related: Known copy, revision or variant of the same original
texts.EducationEvidence:ContextsHint: Full review is confirmed exposure and cannot be cleared. Linked feedback remains unknown until its authorized author reviews the exact delivered version for this question.
texts.EducationEvidence:HintUse:ConfirmedNoHin: This context contains no answers or hints
texts.EducationEvidence:NoContext: No delivery recorded; this does not prove no prior exposure.
texts.EducationEvidence:ContextDecision: Hints for this question in this version
texts.EducationEvidence:ExactContext: I reviewed this exact delivered feedback version and frozen question
texts.EducationEvidence:Confirm: Save this review and refresh the page? Other unsaved reviews on this page will not be saved.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationLearning:InvalidScope: Check the student, teaching, textbook, knowledge point revisions and UTC analysis window.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationLearning:InvalidEvide: The learning evidence is incomplete, inconsistent or outside the authorized scope.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationLearning:InvalidRule: The subject analysis rule or its version does not match this analysis window.
texts.EducationFeedback:Title: Teacher feedback
texts.EducationFeedback:PrivateHint: Only you can read these notes. Save a new observation to correct one. Copying text creates a separate feedback draft.
texts.EducationFeedback:SelectObservation: Copy this text into the feedback draft
texts.EducationFeedback:PublicHint: Remove internal notes before publishing. Select every assessment referenced in the feedback. Saving a draft does not publish it.
texts.EducationFeedback:AssessmentHint: Linked assessments: all must open full review before this feedback becomes accessible. Assessment feedback needs at least one link.
texts.EducationFeedback:ConfirmRecipient: I confirm the student, class, subject and text, and have linked every assessment referenced.
texts.EducationFeedback:PublishPrompt: Publish this saved feedback version to the confirmed student, subject to its review conditions?
texts.EducationFeedback:WithdrawPrompt: Withdraw this feedback? Further reads stop; content already seen cannot be erased. A reason is required.
texts.EducationFeedback:WithdrawnHint: This feedback was withdrawn. Its previous text is no longer available.
texts.EducationFeedback:NoticeHint: Notifications contain no feedback text. Open the current accessible version from the list.
texts.EducationFeedback:NewNotice: New or corrected teacher feedback is available
texts.KnowPulse:EducationFeedback:Invalid: Check the saved content, context, references and required reason.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationFeedback:OperationCon: This operation identifier belongs to another request. Restore the original request.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationFeedback:PreviewChang: The publication preview changed. Refresh it and confirm again.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationFeedback:NotOpen: This feedback is not accessible yet.
texts.EducationGrading:Title: Grading and final results
texts.EducationGrading:Unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Keep this command and query or retry it unchanged, including after signing in again.
texts.EducationGrading:Counts: Assigned {0}; submitted {1}; answering {2}; unstarted {3}; questions pending grading {4}.
texts.EducationGrading:Question: Question
texts.EducationGrading:SubmittedImage: Original answer image; open to enlarge
texts.EducationGrading:Reason: Reason for changing a confirmed score
texts.EducationGrading:ReleaseHint: After the window ends, close all attempts and record absences. Every valid submission must be fully graded before release. Draft grading does not change published scores.
texts.EducationGrading:Close: Close attempts and fix the submission set
texts.EducationGrading:ReleaseReason: Reason for replacing a previous release
texts.EducationGrading:ConfirmVisibility: I confirm the visibility and times shown above, including changes to the task rules.
texts.EducationGrading:Discard: There are unsaved changes or an unconfirmed command. Leave or discard the local changes?
texts.EducationGrading:ConfirmGradePrompt: Confirm the saved point scores and feedback? A correction creates a new version.
texts.EducationGrading:ClosePrompt: Seal confirmed answers, close ongoing attempts and mark unstarted recipients absent?
texts.EducationGrading:PublishPrompt: Release final results for every valid submission with these access rules and opening times?
texts.EducationGrading:NoReceipt: The returned receipt does not match the original command. Query the original operation.
texts.EducationGrading:Absent: Absent: no submitted paper, not a zero score.
texts.EducationGrading:NotOpen: Submitted or awaiting completion. Final results have not opened.
texts.EducationGrading:ReviewNotOpen: Your final score is available. Answers and feedback open with full review.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationAssessment:InvalidGra: The grading information is invalid. Reload the saved draft and check point scores.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationAssessment:GradingInc: Some valid submissions still require grading. Final results cannot be released.
texts.KnowPulse:EducationAssessment:InvalidRes: Result finalization conditions or opening times are invalid. Reload and check them.
texts.EducationQuestion:SavedContentChanged: The recovered draft has changed or been confirmed. Reload and review the saved content before confirming its scoring.
texts.EducationQuestion:Confirmed: Curriculum scoring confirmed. Submit for review separately.
texts.EducationQuestion:ConfirmHint: Save the content, then explicitly confirm curriculum and scoring. Confirmation does not submit or approve the question.
texts.EducationQuestion:ContentChangeHint: Content or scoring changes require curriculum confirmation again.
texts.EducationQuestion:CurrentSelectionRequir: Select an active teaching textbook and assessment points.
texts.EducationQuestion:FrozenScopeHint: The original task curriculum and citations are retained. Allocate scores only to points assessed by this question.
texts.EducationQuestion:InvalidAllocation: Check the total and point allocations: use at most two decimals and allocate the full total.
texts.EducationQuestion:LegacyScopeHint: Existing questions without curriculum retain their enterprise scope.
texts.EducationQuestion:PointScoreHint: Enter points for each knowledge point. Zero excludes it; positive allocations must sum to the total.
texts.EducationQuestion:RecoverHint: The creation outcome is unconfirmed. Check the original operation before creating again.
texts.EducationQuestion:SaveContent: Save content and return to drafts
texts.EducationPaper:ChooseScopeAndQuestions: Select an active curriculum scope and confirmed approved questions.
texts.EducationPaper:ConfirmedQuestionsHint: Only usable, approved questions with confirmed scoring in this curriculum are shown.
texts.EducationPaper:Description: Build, preview and save a personal paper from confirmed curriculum questions.
texts.EducationPaper:EmptyPreview: Select questions to preview the paper.
texts.EducationPaper:FrozenHint: Saved papers retain their questions, curriculum, scoring and sources. Save a new paper for changes.
texts.EducationPaper:InvalidLink: The paper link is invalid. Open a saved paper again.

texts.EducationScoring:Missing: Scoring rules have not been completed.
texts.EducationScoring:DraftHint: A draft may be unfinished. Confirm complete rules before review; changing them requires a new confirmation.
texts.EducationScoring:AllOrNothing: Full credit only for the complete correct selection
texts.EducationScoring:PartialWithoutWrong: Partial credit for a subset of correct choices; any wrong choice gets zero
texts.EducationScoring:MarkerHint: Place each marker once in the stem, in the same order as the blanks. Each blank has its own answer and score.
texts.EducationScoring:MarkerNotUnique: This marker must appear exactly once in the stem before confirmation.
texts.EducationScoring:AnswerLinesHint: Enter one acceptable answer per line, up to 20 answers of 512 characters. Case and whitespace are preserved; equal answers in different blanks remain separate.
texts.EducationScoring:Manual: Teacher grading; no automatic equivalence inference
texts.EducationScoring:TrimWhitespace: Trim leading and trailing whitespace before comparison
texts.EducationScoring:ChooseMapping: Choose a point in the confirmed curriculum scope
texts.EducationScoring:MappingUnavailable: No confirmed point selected, or its mapping is unavailable.
texts.EducationScoring:AllocationFromComponent: Curriculum-point scores are summed from the blanks or scoring points above. Confirm the component total and question total agree.
texts.EducationScoring:InvalidDraft: Check rule lengths, row limits and two-decimal non-negative scores; an incomplete rule can still be saved.
texts.EducationScoring:ConfirmationRequired: Complete the scoring mode, unique ordered blank markers or reference answer and criteria, positive component scores, and curriculum-point allocation before confirmation.
texts.EducationScoring:CurriculumRequired: Create short-answer questions in curriculum mode so scoring rules can be confirmed.
texts.EducationScoring:FrozenRevision: This paper retains the approved question definition and scoring revision.
texts.EducationReview:UnknownResult: A review request is pending confirmation. Recover its recorded result before changing the decision.
texts.EducationReview:RetryHint: The browser stores only an operation receipt. After reloading, re-enter the original comment exactly to retry; recovery does not need the comment.
texts.EducationReview:EventIsHistorical: This confirms that review event; later edits may have changed the question's current status.
texts.EducationReview:CurriculumConfirmed: The teacher has explicitly confirmed curriculum and scoring allocation.
texts.EducationReview:DifferentRequest: The comment or decision differs from the pending request. Recover it, or recheck before starting a new operation.
texts.EducationReview:NoReceipt: No completed receipt was found. The original operation has been retained; retry the same request or check again.
texts.EducationReview:StateChanged: The current question is no longer pending review. Recover the original result or return to the queue.
texts.EducationReview:ConfirmNewDecision: No completed receipt was found and the current question is pending review. Recheck the displayed content, then start a new decision?
texts.KnowPulse:Education:InvalidScoringDefini: The scoring definition is incomplete or invalid. Check the scoring mode, component identity/order, markers, answers, scores and curriculum mapping.
texts.EducationScoring:RepairOrderHint: This draft has unfinished blank or criterion identities/order. Confirm the displayed order before final confirmation.
texts.KnowPulse:Education:FormalDefinitionRequ: The approved question definition is missing. Confirm scoring and review the current draft again.
texts.KnowPulse:Education:QuestionDefinitionRe: This paper requires the matching approved question revision. Reload the formal question and rebuild the paper.
texts.KnowPulse:Education:ReviewConcurrencyReq: Review the loaded version and submit with its version receipt. Reload if the question has changed.
texts.KnowPulse:Education:ReviewOperationConfl: This review operation belongs to another request. Recover its result or start a new operation after checking the question.
texts.KnowPulse:Education:InvalidReviewDecisio: Choose approve, return for revision or reject.
texts.EducationScoring:LegacyAnswerHint: Existing unordered answers are shown for reference only. They are not assigned to blanks; entering blank rules replaces this answer format.
texts.EducationScoring:ChangesNeedConfirmation: Current edits still require a new confirmation.
texts.EducationScoring:CandidateLegacyAnswerHi: This candidate still has answers in the old format. Check them, clear the old list explicitly, and define each blank or criterion below.
texts.EducationScoring:IncompatibleHint: The draft contains rule components for another question type. Remove them explicitly before confirmation.
texts.EducationStudy:Title: Study tasks
texts.EducationStudy:Description: Assign exact materials to a fixed class roster, review student progress and record private follow-up.
texts.EducationStudy:FullClass: All current students in this class
texts.EducationStudy:MaterialDraftHint: Save a draft before choosing materials. Save changes again before previewing recipients. Each task supports up to 10 materials and 10 selected attachments per material.
texts.EducationStudy:RosterCount: Confirm these {0} recipients. Students added after publication do not join this version automatically.
texts.EducationStudy:PublicReason: Student-visible reason for replacement or withdrawal
texts.EducationStudy:ReasonHint: A reason is required after the first publication. Previously assigned students can see this reason; do not include private notes.
texts.EducationStudy:ConfirmPublish: I checked recipients, material rights, attachments and student-safe instructions.
texts.EducationStudy:ConfirmWithdraw: Stop new execution and online material reads for this task. Keep historical submissions and progress. The reason will be visible to students.
texts.EducationStudy:SharedText: Learning summary or difficulty (shared with teacher)
texts.EducationStudy:ConfirmSharing: I agree to share the text above with my teacher.
texts.EducationStudy:ConfirmComplete: I completed this study activity. This does not certify mastery or submit an exam.
texts.EducationStudy:Complete: Hand in summary and mark complete
texts.EducationStudy:Empty: No study tasks are currently assigned to you.
texts.EducationStudy:ConfirmPrivate: This records private handling of the student's current difficulty. The student sees only the handling time.
texts.EducationStudy:LocalReceiptHint: This tab temporarily keeps unconfirmed commands and entered text for retry, separated by account. Use your own device and clear pending commands before leaving a shared device.
texts.EducationStudyHint:Title: Review study material hints
texts.EducationStudyHint:Description: Compare this student's exact delivered task and selected attachments with the frozen question. This decision covers only this recipient and paper question; other contacts and prior attempts remain separate.
texts.EducationStudyHint:CandidatesHint: Only published assessments assigned to this student under your current teaching assignment and overlapping the study points are listed. Up to 3,000 candidate rows can be inspected.
texts.EducationStudyHint:Empty: No matching assigned frozen questions are available.
texts.EducationStudyHint:Provided: First provided to this student at {0}.
texts.EducationStudyHint:MaterialUnavailable: Some exact materials or attachment permissions are unavailable. A new no-hints confirmation is blocked; historical decisions and operation receipts remain.
texts.EducationStudyHint:Exact: I compared the actual delivered version, its selected attachments and this frozen question, including answers, explanations and known variant hints.
texts.EducationStudy:EvidenceHint: Actual material contact starts as unverified. Authorized teachers can review the exact delivered version against each assigned frozen question from student progress. This does not clear other contacts or certify mastery.
texts.EducationStudy:Unavailable: The task content is currently unavailable.
texts.EducationStudy:Availability:Overdue: Past due: reading and difficulty reports remain available
texts.EducationStudy:Availability:Unavailable: Materials or teaching access currently unavailable
texts.KnowPulse:StudyTask:Invalid: Check the task, time window, selected students and confirmations.
texts.KnowPulse:StudyTask:Changed: The saved task changed. Reload and review it before continuing.
texts.KnowPulse:StudyTask:OperationConflict: This operation number belongs to different content. Recover its original receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:StudyTask:RosterChanged: The roster changed. Preview and confirm the current recipients again.
texts.KnowPulse:StudyTask:Closed: This version cannot accept new execution now. Historical submissions are retained.
texts.EducationCorrection:Title: Correction tasks and reviews
texts.EducationCorrection:Separate: Original answers, correction submissions and reviews are retained separately. Corrections do not automatically change scores or mastery.
texts.EducationCorrection:LocalNotice: Drafts stay in this browser on this device. Use care on shared devices and clear them afterwards. Only explicitly submitted copies are shared with the teacher. Uploading an image does not submit it.
texts.EducationCorrection:StorageBroken: Local records cannot be read or storage is unavailable. Recover or explicitly abandon them first; your draft may not be saved.
texts.EducationCorrection:Conflict: The server has a different submission version. This draft keeps its original base. Compare the history below before choosing.
texts.EducationCorrection:Rebase: Keep draft and use latest submission as base
texts.EducationCorrection:RebaseConfirm: Have you compared the latest submission with this local draft? Keep local text and images as a new version based on the latest submission. A new preview and explicit submission are still required. Continue?
texts.EducationCorrection:AddImage: Add correction image (up to 5, 5 MB each; PNG/JPEG/WebP)
texts.EducationCorrection:LocalSaved: Draft saved on this device; it has not been submitted to the teacher.
texts.EducationCorrection:ShareConfirm: I checked the text and images and confirm sharing this correction copy with the teacher.
texts.EducationCorrection:ReselectImage: The previous image upload is unconfirmed. Reselect the same file: {0}
texts.EducationCorrection:WrongImage: The selected file differs from the pending image. Recover the original operation or explicitly abandon it before uploading another file.
texts.EducationCorrection:Original: Original question, answer and released review
texts.EducationCorrection:CreateFromGrade: Select a student's question in grading and choose Assign correction to create a task.
texts.EducationCorrection:PublishConfirm: I checked the fixed student, original grade and release scope, and confirm that the instructions contain no private teacher notes.
texts.EducationCorrection:WithdrawConfirm: Stop further submissions for this task and retain past submitted copies.
texts.EducationCorrection:ReviewTarget: This review targets submission {0}; other submitted copies remain unchanged.
texts.EducationCorrection:ReviewConfirm: Confirm publishing the decision and feedback for this exact submitted version to the student.
texts.EducationCorrection:Availability:SourceC: Original grade changed; await an updated task
texts.EducationCorrection:Availability:Unavail: Current teaching relation does not permit this task
texts.KnowPulse:Correction:Invalid: The correction operation could not be completed. Refresh and check the current task, preview and original receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:Correction:Changed: The correction operation could not be completed. Refresh and check the current task, preview and original receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:Correction:Closed: The correction operation could not be completed. Refresh and check the current task, preview and original receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:Correction:OperationConflict: The correction operation could not be completed. Refresh and check the current task, preview and original receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:Correction:ImageUnavailable: The correction operation could not be completed. Refresh and check the current task, preview and original receipt.
texts.EducationCorrection:FinishEditing: Save the task draft or publish the current review before editing the other section. You can also refresh and explicitly discard the current edits.
texts.EducationWorkload:Title: My learning schedule and workload
texts.EducationWorkload:Scope: Combine your authorized current plan activities, material tasks, corrections and assessments by UTC due date and subject. The maximum window is 31 days; the end date is exclusive.
texts.EducationWorkload:Estimate: This is a per-source planning estimate, not measured study time or mastery. Corrections awaiting teacher review are excluded; required revisions use the original estimate. Bound assessments count once; an ongoing exam is capped by its remaining time limit. Opening a task rechecks its version and time window.
texts.EducationWorkload:Unestimated: {0} current plans have unavailable sources; their dates cannot be checked against this window.
texts.EducationWorkload:Omitted: These kinds and sources that depend on them are omitted because their feature permissions are unavailable:
texts.EducationWorkload:Partial: Blocked, overdue and unestimated work is excluded from known planned minutes. A zero total does not mean there is nothing to resolve; check the details or contact your teacher.
texts.EducationWorkload:Daily: Learning schedule by UTC due date and subject
texts.EducationWorkload:Empty: No schedule items are listed for this filter; still check permissions and unestimated-work notices.
texts.EducationWorkload:Calculated: Per-source checks completed at {0}; sources can change afterwards.
texts.KnowPulse:LearningWorkload:InvalidWindow: Choose a valid UTC window with an exclusive end later than the start and no more than 31 days apart.
texts.KnowPulse:LearningWorkload:Capacity: The schedule exceeds the aggregation limit. Narrow the window or ask your teacher to organize historical tasks. No partial total was returned.
texts.EducationNotebook:Title: My notebook
texts.EducationNotebook:PrivateDescription: Your account's private cloud notes. Teachers and school administrators do not automatically have access. To share assessed work, review and submit it in the assigned task.
texts.EducationNotebook:SaveHint: After creating an entry, save a content version and confirm each attachment upload. Unsaved input may be lost when leaving or refreshing. Organize chapters and knowledge points with your own private tags.
texts.EducationNotebook:SourceHint: Open assigned materials and assessment reviews from their original tasks, under current permissions. This notebook does not automatically copy restricted content or change your answers, grades or mastery.
texts.EducationNotebook:ReferenceHint: References store exact task version identifiers, not questions, answers, or material bodies. They grant no source access. Removing a reference deletes neither the note nor the task. Operation receipts stay in this browser session and can be recovered after refresh.
texts.EducationNotebook:ReferenceThisSource: Reference this source in a note
texts.EducationNotebook:NoSources: No sources linked to this version.
texts.EducationNotebook:SourceUnavailable: The source is currently unavailable. Your note remains subject to your own access rights.
texts.EducationNotebook:AddSource: Link source to this note version
texts.EducationNotebook:InvalidReceipt: Invalid local receipt. Check server records before clearing it.
texts.EducationNotebook:AbandonReceipt: Clear this session receipt and reload sources? This does not undo an operation already saved on the server.
texts.KnowPulse:NotebookSource:Invalid: Invalid notebook source reference. Check the source again.
texts.KnowPulse:NotebookSource:Unavailable: The source is unavailable. Refresh and check current permissions.
texts.KnowPulse:NotebookSource:Conflict: The operation identifier or source already exists. Check the receipt and refresh.
texts.KnowPulse:NotebookSource:Limit: Reference limit reached: 20 per version and 200 per note including removed records.
texts.EducationPractice:Title: Same-question practice
texts.EducationPractice:PracticeOnly: This repeat is a separate record. It does not replace your first answer, change official grades or mastery, or add independent questions.
texts.EducationPractice:LocalHint: Unsubmitted text, image selections and pending receipts stay in this browser session and may be lost when it closes. Teachers cannot read them. Image bytes are not kept here; reselect the same file to retry an uncertain upload.
texts.EducationPractice:TeacherHint: Only explicitly submitted copies appear here. Starts, private drafts and unselected uploads are not shared. Automatic marks are practice references, not official grades or independent mastery evidence.
texts.EducationPractice:SourceUnavailable: The original review or source version is unavailable. This round cannot continue or show feedback. Your submitted response remains traceable under your current access rights.
texts.EducationPractice:CheckCopy: Check this response and selected images
texts.EducationPractice:ManualCheck: Some parts require human judgment. No automatic total is available. Check the criteria; ungraded does not mean zero.
texts.EducationPractice:ConfirmSharing: I confirm sharing the response and selected original images above with the original task teacher as a separate practice record.
texts.EducationPractice:ConfirmPracticeOnly: I understand this does not replace the first answer, official grade or independent mastery evidence.
texts.EducationPractice:ImageLimits: Select up to 5 JPEG, PNG or WebP images, 5 MB each. Original bytes are retained; display rotation and order can change.
texts.EducationPractice:RetryImage: Upload not confirmed. Check its receipt or reselect the same file to retry. Uploading alone does not submit the response.
texts.EducationPractice:ChooseOriginalSubmissi: Open these records from an original submission in teacher grading.
texts.EducationPractice:InvalidReceipt: Invalid local receipt. Check server records before clearing local state.
texts.EducationPractice:AccountChanged: The account changed. Refresh to continue. The previous account's draft will not be saved under this account.
texts.EducationPractice:DiscardLocal: Discard unsubmitted text, image selections and pending commands in this browser session? Check server receipts first. Saved server records are not undone.
texts.EducationPractice:Abandon: Check server records first. Clear the pending command? Your local response stays; already completed starts, uploads and submissions are not undone.
texts.KnowPulse:Practice:SourceUnavailable: This source review/version is unavailable. Return to the original result.
texts.KnowPulse:Practice:Conflict: This operation conflicts with an existing practice record. Check the receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:Practice:ImageUnavailable: The practice image is unavailable or exceeds the upload limits.
texts.EducationFeedback:PhraseHint: Only you can manage these phrases across your current teaching schools. Do not include student identities or private observations. Selecting one only replaces local feedback text; adapt it, save, preview and confirm publication. Updating or archiving a phrase does not change saved feedback.
texts.EducationFeedback:PhraseCompare: Current cloud text for comparison only; your local text and original baseline remain unchanged.
texts.EducationFeedback:UsePhrasePrompt: Read this phrase's current version and replace this student's feedback text? Adapt it for this student, associate assessment facts, then save, preview and confirm publication.
texts.EducationFeedback:ArchivePhrasePrompt: Confirm toggling this phrase's archived status? Revision history and existing saved or published feedback are preserved.
texts.EducationFeedback:PhraseUnavailable: This phrase is archived or unavailable. Refresh the list.
texts.EducationCollection:Title: My question references
texts.EducationCollection:Hint: Save only a reference to the frozen question, without copying its text, answers or images. Review still requires current full-review access and collection authorization. Saving a reference does not label a question as wrong or change first answers, grades or mastery.
texts.EducationCollection:Unavailable: The source, school relationship or access gate is unavailable. A reference cannot restore restricted content. You may still check records or remove an existing reference under current authority.
texts.EducationCollection:ChooseSource: To add a reference, return to the original result and select this question after checking the current full review. An existing reference can be removed here.
texts.EducationCollection:SourceAvailable: Current full review is available through the original result; opening checks authorization again.
texts.EducationCollection:ConfirmCollect: Save this question reference without copying text, answers or images? This does not change first answers, grades or mastery. Later review still requires current full-review and collection authorization.
texts.EducationCollection:ConfirmRemove: Remove this reference? Operation history, answers, grades and practice records remain unchanged.
texts.EducationCollection:AbandonPrompt: Close only local tracking, without undoing a possibly completed operation, then read the current state?
texts.EducationCollection:Empty: No references in this school. This does not imply an absence of mistakes or learning needs.
texts.KnowPulse:QuestionCollection:Invalid: The collection action or baseline is invalid. Check the current state and original receipt.
texts.KnowPulse:QuestionCollection:SourceUnava: Current full review or collection authorization is unavailable. Check the original result.
texts.KnowPulse:QuestionCollection:Conflict: The operation ID conflicts with an existing collection record. Check the original receipt.
texts.EducationReminder:ScopeHint: Current school and relationships are checked again. In-app delivery, WeChat delivery, reading and starting are separate facts. WeChat is not configured; no WeChat message is sent.
texts.EducationReminder:RecoveryHint: Only operation/scope IDs and the original preview fingerprint are stored. Recover the original receipt first. Retrying keeps the same recipient; closing tracking does not undo a possible delivery.
texts.EducationReminder:Retry: Recover, then retry the original operation
texts.EducationReminder:Sent: In-app reminder confirmed. WeChat is not configured; no WeChat delivery was attempted.
texts.EducationReminder:FrequencyHint: Allow at least one hour between reminders for the same task and student. Next allowed at
texts.EducationReminder:Confirm: I checked the recipient, task and status. Send only a generic in-app notice without grades, answers or private observations.
texts.EducationReminder:GenericMessage: Your teacher asks you to check an assessment task
texts.EducationReminder:Open: Read reminder and view current task
texts.EducationReminder:Empty: No records in the current scope.
texts.EducationReminder:Failed: The scope, state or receipt could not be confirmed. Recover the original receipt before refreshing the preview. No automatic retry is made.
texts.EducationReminder:StorageFailed: Local operation tracking could not be saved or cleared. No untracked new reminder will be sent. Check the original receipt.
texts.EducationReminder:NotFound: No receipt found yet. Keep the original IDs and explicitly retry the same operation.
texts.EducationReminder:ClosedTracking: Local tracking closed. A possible in-app delivery is not undone.
texts.EducationReminder:PlanStopped: Linked plan is stopped or unavailable
texts.EducationReminder:CoolingDown: A reminder was sent within the last hour
texts.KnowPulse:EducationAssessment:ReminderUn: The current state or reminder interval prevents another notice. Refresh the preview.
texts.EducationReminder:MessageManual: Your teacher asks you to check an assessment task
texts.EducationReminder:MessageAssignment: You have a new assessment assignment
texts.EducationReminder:MessageResultReleased: An assessment result update is available within your permitted viewing scope
texts.EducationReminder:SourceChanged: The source link is incomplete, replaced or hidden. You may mark the message read; explicitly select the current result. No automatic version switch is made.
texts.EducationReminder:OpenSource: Read message and open its source
texts.EducationInbox:Title: In-app messages
texts.EducationInbox:Hint: Assessment, feedback and teaching plan messages for the current school. Message reading, content reading, completion and exam starts are separate facts. WeChat is not configured; no delivery is attempted.
texts.EducationInbox:MessagePlanPublished: Your teacher has published a new teaching plan
texts.EducationInbox:MessagePlanExecutionChang: A teaching plan execution status changed; check its current arrangements
texts.EducationInbox:MessageDifficultyHandled: Your teacher handled a learning difficulty you reported; check the activity
texts.EducationInbox:MessageReminder: Your teacher asks you to check an assessment
texts.EducationInbox:MessageAssignment: You have a new assessment assignment
texts.EducationInbox:MessageResultReleased: An assessment result update is available within your viewing scope
texts.EducationInbox:MessageFeedbackChanged: Your teacher has updated feedback for you
texts.EducationInbox:SourceUnavailable: The source was withdrawn or changed. You can mark the message read, then explicitly reselect from its original entry. No automatic version switch is made.
texts.EducationInbox:Open: Read message and open its source
texts.EducationInbox:Empty: No currently authorized messages in this source.
texts.AccountHelp:Title: Account and WeChat binding help
texts.AccountHelp:Intro: Teachers and students use the same verified account. Recover the original account to continue its materials and learning records; school identities require separate verification.
texts.AccountHelp:NotConfigured: The account verification address is not correctly configured. Ask the platform administrator to check the deployment.
texts.AccountHelp:PasswordHint: Open account verification, check the displayed tenant and the original registered email, then follow the verification email. Keep the original account instead of creating another one for its records.
texts.AccountHelp:Binding: Change device or manage WeChat binding
texts.AccountHelp:BindingHint: Sign in on the web to the original account you intend to keep, verify the displayed account, revoke your old binding, then issue a new limited-time code for your own WeChat. Materials, answers and school records remain.
texts.AccountHelp:SchoolHint: Check school invitations, workspace and your own teaching relations. Login and unbinding do not create memberships, teaching or enrollment, or transfer personal materials.
texts.AccountHelp:Unable: Unable to verify the original account
texts.AccountHelp:UnableHint: If verification mail does not arrive or account information cannot be matched, contact school or platform support to verify the original record. Do not send passwords, verification codes or binding codes to others. A matching name or class code cannot establish account ownership.
texts.AccountHelp:LearningHint: Signing in again or changing device does not reset server exam timers. Only server-confirmed content can be recovered across devices; check unsynchronized answers and original operation receipts first.
texts.RelationRequests:Title: My teaching relations and correction requests
texts.RelationRequests:ManageHint: Verify the exact account, original relation and actual scope. Ending teaching affects subsequent access; check unfinished teaching work first. Tasks and historical attribution are not transferred. The requesting teacher can read the resolution.
texts.RelationRequests:TeacherHint: Review your relations or ask the school to add or correct them. Requests grant no access; school confirmation is required. Personal assets and historical attribution stay unchanged.
texts.RelationRequests:Original: Select the original relation or explicitly report a missing one
texts.RelationRequests:Missing: Missing relation; ask the school to add it
texts.RelationRequests:Text: Describe the class, subject, dates and reason to check; omit unrelated student information
texts.RelationRequests:Sharing: Share this explanation with this school's managers
texts.RelationRequests:Changed: The original relation changed or ended. Explain why no change is made or ask for a new request; do not rewrite history using the old request.
texts.RelationRequests:ResultHint: A past resolution does not prove current teaching access. Original relations and attribution remain; personal assets are not transferred. Refresh the workspace to check current scope.
texts.RelationRequests:Reviewed: I verified the account, current relation, class, subject and dates, and approve sharing the resolution with the requesting teacher
texts.RelationRequests:SubmitConfirm: Send this teaching relation correction to the selected school's managers? The request itself does not change teaching or access scope.
texts.RelationRequests:WithdrawConfirm: Withdraw this pending request? Existing teaching relations remain as recorded.
texts.RelationRequests:ResolveConfirm: Apply '{1}' for {0}? Check the selected school, class, subject and dates. The resolution and actual relation changes are saved together.
texts.RelationRequests:Recorded: The original operation was verified. Refresh the workspace to check actual scope; a past resolution or receipt does not restore an ended relation.
texts.RelationRequests:Leave: Leaving discards unsent text and the in-memory request. Saved operation identifiers can still be checked. Leaving cannot undo a server operation that may have succeeded. Continue?
texts.RelationRequests:Uncertain: The operation may have succeeded. Check its original receipt first; no automatic resend occurs. Only identifiers are stored locally; text and original requests remain in page memory.
texts.RelationRequests:NoReceipt: No original receipt matches this identifier, action and account. Check the original request; another resolution is not a substitute.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingRelationRequest:Invali: Check the request type, own original relation, explanation, sharing confirmation and actual school resolution scope.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingRelationRequest:Change: The request, original relation or membership changed. Check its original receipt and review again; stale requests are not automatically applied.
texts.KnowPulse:TeachingRelationRequest:Confli: This operation identifier does not match its original request. Check the original receipt instead of overwriting a resolution.
texts.SchoolInvites:ManagerHint: Verify the exact account and school role before issuing a time-limited invitation. Membership starts only after personal confirmation. Teaching and enrollment require separate verification. Only one active pending invitation per account and role is allowed in a school.
texts.SchoolInvites:RecipientHint: Only invitations addressed to this account appear here. Check your identity, school and role; decline and notify the school if anything is incorrect. Existing school membership is not required.
texts.SchoolInvites:Uncertain: The operation may have succeeded. Check its original receipt first; leaving does not resend it. Only identifiers are stored locally. Original inputs stay in page memory. Include processed invitations to locate the original record.
texts.SchoolInvites:Verified: I verified the exact selected account and school role; matching names or a class code do not verify identity
texts.SchoolInvites:InvalidLocal: The local operation reference cannot be verified. Contact the school to check the original record.
texts.SchoolInvites:ConfirmCreate: Invite verified account {0} to join {1} as {2}? Personal confirmation and separate teaching or enrollment verification are still required.
texts.SchoolInvites:RevokeConfirm: Revoke this pending invitation? Revocation does not remove an accepted member; use the existing membership ending process.
texts.SchoolInvites:NoReceipt: No successful receipt matches this operation. Check the original invitation; another operation or current status is not its receipt.
texts.SchoolInvites:Recorded: The original operation was verified. Issuing an invitation is not membership; teaching and enrollment still require school verification.
texts.SchoolInvites:ClearConfirm: Clearing the local reference cannot undo an operation that may have succeeded. Check its original receipt and the school record before clearing.
texts.SchoolInvites:Empty: No invitations addressed to this account in this view.
texts.SchoolInvites:PeriodHint: Membership cannot start before your confirmation. Classes, teaching and score access require separate authorization. A historical acceptance does not prove current membership. Ownership of personal materials stays unchanged.
texts.SchoolInvites:RecipientVerified: I verified that this school and role are intended for me
texts.SchoolInvites:Unavailable: This invitation cannot currently be confirmed. Ask the school to check the issuer's eligibility.
texts.SchoolInvites:AcceptConfirm: Confirm that this invitation is for you: {0}, role {1}? Teaching or enrollment still needs school verification.
texts.SchoolInvites:DeclineConfirm: Decline the {1} invitation from {0} and send the selected reason to the school?
texts.SchoolInvites:Responded: The original operation was verified. Refresh the workspace to check your current identity; membership does not assign a class or teaching role.
texts.KnowPulse:SchoolInvitation:Invalid: Check the account, teacher/student role, validity and explicit confirmation. Invitations last up to seven days and cannot target the issuer.
texts.KnowPulse:SchoolInvitation:Unavailable: The invitation expired, was processed or its issuer is no longer eligible. Check with the school.
texts.KnowPulse:SchoolInvitation:OperationConf: This operation identifier does not match its original request. Check the original receipt instead of overwriting it.
texts.KnowPulse:SchoolInvitation:PendingExists: An active pending invitation for this school, account and role already exists. Process or revoke it first.
texts.EducationInbox:NoSource: This source is unavailable. Explicitly reselect an available source.
texts.EducationInbox:Failed: The message or its access could not be confirmed. Refresh your identity and current source before retrying.
